title: Eleven Minutes and One Fee
subtitle: 咨询与职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 咨询与职业（生活与学习·职业与职场）
meta: 主题语境：咨询与职业（生活与学习·职业与职场）　|　核心词汇：consultant　|　正文 337 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 consultant 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 my father ① called in a consultant who asked eleven questions and answered none, and he said the calling was the whole of the deciding. The ② consultant, meaning the adviser and not the answer, stayed one afternoon and stayed that long; consultant, he said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how many questions it asks.

Every ③ consultant in that building had the same briefcase, and the ④ consultant at the end, meaning the one they kept for the merger and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever called twice. Consultant, my mother said, is nine parts asking and one part somebody willing to pay; my father said the paying is the part that fills the invoice.

My grandmother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the consultant was the whole of the ward, meaning the senior doctor and not the adviser. The ⑥ consultant, meaning the senior doctor and not any of that, is the only person in a ward that everybody waits for and nobody questions; consultant, she said, is either someone you call in or the only word that means both an adviser and a senior doctor. He said the senior doctor is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ consultant had become a line in a budget, and the budget had become an argument about the briefcase. The ⑧ consultant of the whole thing, my father wrote in June, was one afternoon and thirty years of asking; consultant, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to pay. She said the paying was never mentioned.

The ⑨ consultant I remember is the one at the end, who was called in 1987 and is still described as the most questioned in the county. A ⑩ consultant, my mother said in 1989, is the only thing that improves by being asked; every consultant, she said, is a senior doctor that has agreed to look like an adviser. She said the senior doctor was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 顾问（指那位顾问本人，与那个答案相对）
C. 固定搭配：call in a consultant 请来一位顾问
D. n. 顾问（指那栋楼里每一位）
E. n. 顾问（指末尾那一位）
F. n. 高级顾问医师；会诊医生（英式用法）
G. n. 顾问（指预算里提到的那一位）
H. n. 咨询；顾问工作（抽象总称）

answers.why: call in a consultant 意为“请来一位顾问”，1973 年父亲请来了一位问了十一个问题、一个也没回答的顾问。
consultant 意为“顾问”，指那位顾问本人而不是那个答案，他待了一个下午。
consultant 指那栋楼里每一位顾问，每一位都提着同样的公文包。
consultant 指末尾那一位（他们留给合并事宜的那一位），是唯一有人请过两次的。
consultant 意为“高级顾问医师、会诊医生”，祖母说那位高级医师就是那间病房的全部，指的是医生而不是顾问。
consultant 为另一个义项，指医院的高级顾问医师而不是顾问，是病房里人人都等、却无人质疑的那个人。
consultant 意为“顾问”，指预算里提到的那一位，到 1981 年这位顾问成了预算里的一行。
consultant 意为“咨询、顾问工作”，父亲六月写道，整件事的顾问工作是一个下午三十年的提问。
consultant 意为“顾问”，我记得的是末尾那一位，1987 年请来，至今仍被说成全县被问得最多的。
consultant 为抽象总称，母亲说一位顾问是唯一会因为被提问而变好的东西。
